+//! Public modal state, program output, and line-map types for `camcraft-gcode`.
+//! Provenance: modal groups and word meanings from RS-274/NGC (NISTIR 6556) and ISO 6983; output types bind to camcraft-cl (`cl::Toolpath`).
+
+use camcraft_cl::cl::Toolpath;
+
+pub use crate::dialect::{Dialect, DwellUnit, ModalState, ParseOptions, ReferencePositions};
+pub use crate::error::GcodeError;
+
+/// How `I`/`J`/`K` arc center words are interpreted.
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum ArcCenterMode {
+    /// `G91.1`: `I`/`J`/`K` are incremental offsets from the arc start point.
+    #[default]
+    Incremental,
+    /// `G90.1`: `I`/`J`/`K` are absolute coordinates in the active work offset.
+    Absolute,
+}
+
+/// Modal Group 3 distance mode.
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum DistanceMode {
+    /// `G90`: axis words are absolute positions in the active work offset.
+    #[default]
+    Absolute,
+    /// `G91`: axis words are increments from the current position.
+    Incremental,
+}
+
+/// Modal Group 5 feed rate mode.
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum FeedMode {
+    /// `G94`: feed rate in units per minute.
+    #[default]
+    PerMinute,
+}
+
+/// Modal Group 10 canned cycle return level.
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum CycleReturnMode {
+    /// `G98`: return to the initial Z level held before the cycle started.
+    #[default]
+    InitialZ,
+    /// `G99`: return to the `R` retract plane.
+    RPlane,
+}
+
+/// Modal Group 13 path control mode.
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
+pub enum PathControlMode {
+    /// `G61`: exact stop / exact path mode.
+    ExactStop,
+    /// `G64`: continuous path blending, with optional `P` tolerance in mm.
+    Continuous { tolerance_mm: Option<f64> },
+}
+
+impl Default for PathControlMode {
+    fn default() -> Self {
+        PathControlMode::Continuous { tolerance_mm: None }
+    }
+}
+
+/// Spindle rotation state (`M3`/`M4`/`M5`).
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum SpindleDir {
+    #[default]
+    Off,
+    Cw,
+    Ccw,
+}
+
+/// Active coolant channels (`M7`, `M8`, `M9`, `M88`, `M89`).
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct CoolantState {
+    pub flood: bool,
+    pub mist: bool,
+    pub through_spindle: bool,
+}
+
+/// Modal Group 12 work coordinate system (`G54`..`G59`).
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum WorkOffset {
+    #[default]
+    G54 = 1,
+    G55 = 2,
+    G56 = 3,
+    G57 = 4,
+    G58 = 5,
+    G59 = 6,
+}
+
+impl WorkOffset {
+    /// 1-based offset number (1 for `G54` .. 6 for `G59`).
+    #[must_use]
+    pub const fn number(self) -> u8 {
+        self as u8
+    }
+
+    /// 0-based array index (0..6).
+    #[must_use]
+    pub const fn index(self) -> usize {
+        (self as usize) - 1
+    }
+
+    /// RS-274 G-code integer (`54`..`59`).
+    #[must_use]
+    pub const fn g_code(self) -> u8 {
+        53 + (self as u8)
+    }
+}
+
+/// Active canned cycle variant.
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum CycleType {
+    /// `G73`: high-speed chip-breaking peck drilling.
+    ChipBreakPeck,
+    /// `G81`: plain drilling.
+    Drill,
+    /// `G82`: drilling with bottom dwell.
+    DwellDrill,
+    /// `G83`: deep-hole full-retract peck drilling.
+    DeepPeck,
+    /// `G84`: right-hand tapping.
+    Tap,
+    /// `G85`: reaming / boring feed-in, feed-out.
+    Ream,
+    /// `G86`: boring feed-in, spindle stop, rapid retract.
+    Bore,
+    /// `G89`: boring feed-in, bottom dwell, feed-out.
+    BackBore,
+}
+
+/// Active modal Group 1 motion state.
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum MotionMode {
+    /// Cancelled (`G80`) or unset before the first Group 1 code.
+    #[default]
+    None,
+    /// `G0`: rapid positioning.
+    Rapid,
+    /// `G1`: linear interpolation at active feed rate.
+    Linear,
+    /// `G2`: clockwise circular/helical arc.
+    ArcCw,
+    /// `G3`: counterclockwise circular/helical arc.
+    ArcCcw,
+    /// `G73`/`G81`..`G89`: modal canned drilling/boring/tapping cycle.
+    Cycle(CycleType),
+}
+
+/// One `G4` dwell recorded in the program.
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
+pub struct DwellEvent {
+    pub line: usize,
+    pub seconds: f64,
+    pub section: usize,
+    pub after_move: Option<usize>,
+}
+
+/// `M0` program stop or `M1` optional stop.
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum StopKind {
+    ProgramStop,
+    OptionalStop,
+}
+
+/// One `M0`/`M1` stop recorded in the program.
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct StopEvent {
+    pub line: usize,
+    pub kind: StopKind,
+    pub section: usize,
+    pub after_move: Option<usize>,
+}
+
+/// `M2` or `M30` program end marker.
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum ProgramEnd {
+    M2,
+    M30,
+}
+
+/// One move-to-source-line mapping entry (1-based line number).
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct MoveLine {
+    pub section: usize,
+    pub move_index: usize,
+    pub line: usize,
+}
+
+/// Mapping between emitted `cl::Move` indices and 1-based NC source line numbers.
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct LineMap {
+    pub entries: Vec<MoveLine>,
+}
+
+impl LineMap {
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
+        self.entries.is_empty()
+    }
+
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
+        self.entries.len()
+    }
+
+    /// 1-based line number for `(section, move_index)`.
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn line_for(&self, section: usize, move_index: usize) -> Option<usize> {
+        self.entries
+            .iter()
+            .find(|e| e.section == section && e.move_index == move_index)
+            .map(|e| e.line)
+    }
+
+    /// All `(section, move_index)` pairs emitted by 1-based `line`.
+    pub fn moves_on_line(&self, line: usize) -> impl Iterator<Item = (usize, usize)> + '_ {
+        self.entries
+            .iter()
+            .filter(move |e| e.line == line)
+            .map(|e| (e.section, e.move_index))
+    }
+}
+
+/// One tool section of a parsed NC program.
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
+pub struct ParsedSection {
+    pub index: usize,
+    pub tool_number: Option<u32>,
+    pub work_offset: WorkOffset,
+    pub length_offset: Option<u32>,
+    pub spindle_rpm: Option<f64>,
+    pub spindle_dir: SpindleDir,
+    pub coolant: CoolantState,
+    pub toolpath: Toolpath,
+    /// 1-based NC line number aligned 1-to-1 with `toolpath.moves`.
+    pub move_lines: Vec<usize>,
+}
+
+/// Complete parsed result for a 3-axis RS-274/ISO 6983 program.
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
+pub struct ParsedProgram {
+    pub program_number: Option<u32>,
+    pub sections: Vec<ParsedSection>,
+    pub line_map: LineMap,
+    pub dwells: Vec<DwellEvent>,
+    pub stops: Vec<StopEvent>,
+    pub ended: Option<ProgramEnd>,
+    pub tools: Vec<u32>,
+    pub final_modal: ModalState,
+}
+
+impl ParsedProgram {
+    /// Iterator over each section's `cl::Toolpath`.
+    pub fn toolpaths(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &Toolpath> + '_ {
+        self.sections.iter().map(|s| &s.toolpath)
+    }
+
+    /// 1-based NC line number for `(section, move_index)`.
+    #[must_use]
+    pub fn line_for_move(&self, section: usize, move_index: usize) -> Option<usize> {
+        self.sections
+            .get(section)
+            .and_then(|s| s.move_lines.get(move_index).copied())
+    }
+}

+//! Degenerate-input tests for `camcraft-gcode`: malformed programs give a value or a refusal, never a panic or a hang.
+//! Provenance: AGENTS.md Prime Directive (degenerate input gives a clean error); inputs follow RS-274/NGC (NISTIR 6556) word syntax.
+//! Gate map: covers camcraft_gcode::{lexer, block, block_codes, arc, cycle, motion, interp}.
+
+use std::sync::mpsc;
+use std::thread;
+use std::time::Duration;
+
+use camcraft_gcode::parse;
+
+/// Parse `nc` on a worker thread. Fail on a panic, or when no answer arrives in five seconds.
+fn parses_without_panic_or_hang(nc: &'static str) {
+    let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel();
+    let worker = thread::spawn(move || {
+        let ok = parse(nc).is_ok();
+        let _ = tx.send(ok);
+    });
+    match rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5)) {
+        Ok(_) => assert!(worker.join().is_ok(), "parse panicked for {nc:?}"),
+        Err(mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Disconnected) => panic!("parse panicked for {nc:?}"),
+        Err(mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Timeout) => panic!("parse did not return in 5 s for {nc:?}"),
+    }
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn degenerate_programs_refuse_or_parse_without_panic_or_hang() {
+    let cases: &[&'static str] = &[
+        "",
+        "


",
+        "%
%
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X1.G1 Y2. F100
",
+        "G21 G90
X
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X-
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X1e999
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X1.2.3
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X99999999999999999999999999999999999999.
",
+        "G21 G90
G1 X10. F0
",
+        "G21 G90
G1 X10. F-5
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X0 Y0
G2 X0 Y0 I0 J0 F100
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X0 Y0
G2 X10. Y0 R0 F100
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X0 Y0
G2 X100. Y0 R1. F100
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X0 Y0 Z5.
G83 X0 Y0 Z-10. R2. Q0 F100
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X0 Y0 Z5.
G83 X0 Y0 Z-10. R2. Q-1. F100
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X0 Y0 Z5.
G73 X0 Y0 Z-10. R2. Q0.000001 F100
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X0 Y0 Z5.
G81 X0 Y0 Z-10. R2. L999999999999 F100
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X0 Y0 Z5.
G81 X0 Y0 Z-10. R2. L-3 F100
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X0 Y0 Z5.
G81 X0 Y0 Z10. R2. F100
",
+        "G21 G90
G4 P-1.
",
+        "G21 G90
T99999999999 M6
",
+        "G21 G90
S-100 M3
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X\u{00e9}1.
",
+        "G21 G90
(unclosed comment
G0 X1.
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 X1. ; trailing
N99999999999999999999 G0 X2.
",
+        "G21 G90
G0 G1 G2 G3 X1.
",
+        "G21 G20 G0 X1.
",
+    ];
+    for nc in cases {
+        parses_without_panic_or_hang(nc);
+    }
+}

+## #2217 - camcraft-gcode crate for RS-274/ISO 6983 3-axis milling
+
+**What was decided.**
+- Created `crates/gcode` (`camcraft-gcode`) as a pure-Rust library beside `crates/post`, depending only on `camcraft-cl`, `camcraft-geometry`, and `thiserror`. Registered `"crates/gcode"` in root `Cargo.toml` and added `"gcode"` after `"cl"` in `xtask/src/plan.rs` (`BATCH_CRATES`, `ALL_CRATES`, `CLIPPY`) plus updated `xtask/src/tests.rs` to count `plan::ALL_CRATES.len()`.
+- Accepted caller-supplied `ParseOptions` combining `Dialect` (`default_arc_center`, `default_unit: None` by default so missing `G20`/`G21` refuses unless overridden, `cycle_dwell_unit`, `g4_dwell_unit`, `arc_radius_tolerance_mm`, `chip_break_retract_mm`, `initial_position`, with presets `rs274`, `fanuc`, `haas`, `tormach`, `grblhal`, `tinyg`, `carvera`) and `ReferencePositions` (`g28`, `g30`, `g53_origin`, per-WCS `wcs_origins`).
+- Implemented lexer, block modal-group conflict checker, arc solver (`I`/`J`/`K` in `G90.1`/`G91.1` and signed `R` in `G17`/`G18`/`G19`), canned-cycle expander (`G73`, `G81`, `G82`, `G83`, `G84`, `G85`, `G86`, `G89` with `G98`/`G99` and `L` repeats into explicit `cl::Move` chains and `cl::Cycle` records), tool-change section splitting (`T`/`M6`), and 1-based source line mapping (`ParsedSection::move_lines` and `LineMap`).
+- Refused unsupported features and malformed blocks by name with the 1-based line number: unknown words, missing unit mode (`G20`/`G21`), `G41`/`G42`/`D`, `G43.4`, `G93`/`G95`, macro calls/variables (`G65`/`G66`/`G67`, `M98`/`M99`, `#`, `[`, `]`, `=`, `IF`/`GOTO`/`WHILE`/`SUB`), probing (`G31`/`G38.2`), `R` full circles, missing `G28`/`G30`/`G53` reference positions, and rotary words (`A`/`B`/`C`).
+- Recorded new internal crate edges:
+  - `camcraft-gcode -> camcraft-cl`: imports `cl::{ArcPlane, Cycle, CycleKind, MoveKind, PathBuilder, Toolpath, lattice}` (`>= 5` items). Caller cannot pass these in because `camcraft-gcode` constructs `cl::Toolpath` sections and `cl::Cycle` metadata directly as its parsed output product. Rebuild impact: changing `camcraft-cl` rebuilds `camcraft-gcode`.
+  - `camcraft-gcode -> camcraft-geometry`: imports `geo2d::Point2` and `geometry::{Point3, units::{from_display, Unit, MM_PER_INCH}}` (`5` items). Caller cannot pass raw floats instead because `Toolpath` endpoints, arc centers, and exact micron-lattice inch conversion (`from_display` / `lattice`) bind to `camcraft-geometry` types. Rebuild impact: changing `camcraft-geometry` rebuilds `camcraft-gcode`.
+
+**Why.**
+- Keeping `camcraft-gcode` free of `boa_engine`, `flecs_ecs`, and `camcraft-post` lets callers, simulator round-trip tests, and verification tooling parse posted NC programs with minimal dependencies and fast incremental builds.
+- Splitting full 360° `I/J/K` circles at the opposite point into two 180° `push_arc_in` calls preserves them because `cl::PathBuilder` treats zero in-plane chord arcs as straight moves; aligning `SectionBuilder::push_arc` on `moves_len()` before/after automatically attributes both halves and any vertical Z-extremum splits to the same 1-based source line.
+- Refusing unconfigured `G28`/`G30`/`G53` reference positions instead of guessing `(0, 0, 0)` avoids silent coordinate shifts when machine home is off work zero.
+
+**What was considered and dropped.**
+- *Depending on `camcraft-post` for `Dialect` presets*: rejected because it would pull `boa_engine` into `camcraft-gcode`; instead `camcraft-gcode::Dialect` carries the small subset of controller rules (arc center default, `P` dwell units) and later callers in `camcraft-post` or `camcraft-app` can map a post machine/dialect onto it.
+- *Evaluating fanuc macro variables (`#`) or `M98` subprograms in v1*: rejected so the 3-axis parser stays deterministic and never mis-executes control flow; left cleanly separated for a future macro preprocessor if needed.
+- *Silent fallback to `G21` mm when unit mode is absent*: rejected so unitless programs cannot scale inches as millimeters silently.
+
+**Continuation on current main (qsmits, 2026-11-23).**
+- Kept commit `711314efd` (Mike Kinney) by a merge of it into main `60376ccbb`. The three conflicts were lists only: the root `members` line and the `BATCH_CRATES` / `ALL_CRATES` / `CLIPPY` lines in `xtask/src/plan.rs` now hold both `"gcode"` (after `"cl"`) and main's `"gpu"`; the release step count in `xtask/src/tests.rs` keeps main's known-fail `checks` term and the held `plan::ALL_CRATES.len()` term.
+- Main's later xtask tests list the crates by hand. `heavy_plan_tests::reach_follows_the_crate_dependencies` now expects `gcode` in the reach of `geometry` (the edge `camcraft-gcode -> camcraft-geometry` puts it there). `step_tests::batch_prebuild_leaves_suite_steps_fresh_with_truck_dev_dep` writes a stub `crates/gcode` for its fixture workspace.
+- Both test files name their modules in a `Gate map: covers camcraft_gcode::{..}` line, so quick selects them for a change of any `crates/gcode/src` module. Added `tests/degenerate_input.rs`: malformed programs (empty, huge numbers, zero radius, `Q0` pecks, huge `L` repeats, bad comments) give a value or a refusal, with no panic and no hang (5 s limit for each case).
+- Rebuild impact of the two edges, restated: a change in `camcraft-geometry` or `camcraft-cl` rebuilds `camcraft-gcode`. No crate depends on `camcraft-gcode` yet, so a change in it rebuilds nothing else. The batch, release and clippy plans each get one more crate.
+
+**What it would cost to change later.**
+- Adding a new dialect field or mapping from `camcraft-post` / `.cps` headers is additive on `Dialect` with `..Dialect::rs274()`.
+- Supporting cutter compensation or macro expansion later only requires extending `block_codes` and `lexer` behind explicit `ParseOptions` opt-in without altering existing 3-axis section output.
